verdict.rationale: Angular is a client-side web application framework with a CLI, not a hosted service that emits platform events, so registrable outbound HTTP webhooks are outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Angular shipping a webhook capability. Its component event bindings (e.g. (click), @Output) are in-app DOM and component events, not webhooks, and do not make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
